atten3.ptxt: When using TaSCAN with the IG OFF, repeatedly turn any of the door courtesy light switches ON and OFF (ON/OFF interval within 1.5 seconds) until communication between TaSCAN and the vehicle starts.

step2.ptxt: With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, display the "System Diagnosis Menu/Main Body" screen and select "DTC".

atten4.ptxt: DTCs are output even with the ignition switch OFF.

step2.ptxt: With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, display the "System Diagnosis Menu/Main Body" screen and select "DTC".
Select "Clear" on the screen to clear the data.
Check the DTCs again, and confirm that the malfunction codes have been cleared and the normal code is displayed.

atten3.ptxt: If a malfunction code is output, repair again according to the code.
